Desirable: Experience in RPA/ LAMP/ isothermal amplification/ CRISPR-Cas12a based diagnostics, Experience in CRISPR-Cas integrated molecular biology studies, Publications in peer review journals in the area. Desirable: Research experience in plant molecular biology, or analysis of transgenic/ GM plants, Publications in peer review journals in the area.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR NBPGR Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment drive is being conducted by the ICAR National Bureau of Plant Genetic Resources (ICAR NBPGR).

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in ICAR NBPGR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts are Research Associate - III and Young Professional - II under temporary research positions.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the announced posts.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is completely through a Walk-in interview process.

faq.question: Q5. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for both Research Associate - III and Young Professional - II is scheduled for 23 October 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for Research Associate - III?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. (Doctoral) Degree in Science (Molecular Biology/Biotechnology/Biochemistry/Life Sciences/Genetics/Plant Genetic Resources).

faq.question: Q7. What is the qualification required for Young Professional - II?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Master's degree in Science (Biotechnology/Molecular Biology/Biochemistry/Life Sciences/Genetics & Plant Breeding/Plant Genetic Resources).

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for Research Associate - III?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for Research Associate - III will receive a monthly salary of ₹67,000 plus 27% HRA.

faq.question: Q9. What is the age limit for the posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 40 years for Research Associate - III and 45 years for Young Professional - II.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location?
faq.answer: The job location for these positions is New Delhi, Delhi (Pincode: 110012).
